summary: Adagene Inc. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that China's NMPA cleared its IND application for ADG138, a double-masked HER2xCD3 bispecific T-cell engager built on its SAFEbody platform. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation are stated; this is a routine clinical/regulatory milestone disclosure. A first-in-human Phase 1 trial in advanced solid tumors is expected to begin in China in Q4 2026. No deal or special-situation mechanics apply; watch pipeline execution and any future partnering or financing catalysts.
